title: Five-Year Outcomes Following Therapeutic Plasma Exchange in Children and Adolescents with Myasthenia, Multiple Sclerosis, Guillain–Barré Syndrome, and Autoimmune Encephalitis: A Retrospective Single-Center Study
summary:
Background:
Therapeutic plasma exchange may be used in children and adolescents with certain severe diseases affecting the nervous system. Limited data are available on the long-term health outcomes of these patients following treatment.

Research question:
The study aims to describe the long-term health outcomes of children and adolescents following therapeutic plasma exchange.

Methodology:
Existing medical records of children and adolescents treated at University Hospital Essen between 2016 and 2026 will be reviewed. No additional examinations or interventions will be performed, and patients and their parents or legal guardians will not be contacted. The data will be analyzed in anonymized form.

interventions.name: Retrospective Study of Children and Adolescents Undergoing Therapeutic Plasma Exchange Between 2016 and 2026

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) 2016-2026
